messages:
maria: FYI — Q2 Optimize toolkit scope call. We need to finalize what's in MVP vs beta for batching / caching / quantization recommendations and eval-triggered alerts.

ajay: quick thought — MVP should be advice-only: UI + REST endpoint that returns recommended config. No automatic apply in MVP.

maria: agree. Customer asks (Beth/Acme) are pushing for per-customer quant recs + eval alerts. Proposal: beta for auto-suggest & preview, MVP for advice-only.

beth: Acme here — priorities are cost reduction without tail latency regressions. We're ok with preview rollout behind a feature flag.

tom: infra note — per-tenant quant recs imply variantization. Two paths: offline scoring job (cheaper, slower cadence) or online heuristics (low-latency, higher infra). Offline seems safer for MVP.

claire: SRE constraints — we can't tolerate p99 regressions on the hosted text-gen path. Set hard guard: no >10ms increase vs baseline for MVP canaries.

maria: suggested acceptance criteria (MVP):
  1) Advisor returns batching + prefix-caching recommendations for 80% of common request routes.
  2) Quantization recommender provides per-model suggestions (top 3 open-source models we ship).
  3) Eval-triggered alerts fire when a customer's eval set shows >3% regression in quality metric (or user-defined threshold).

ajay: engineering estimate: 6 weeks if we scope to advice-only + offline quant pipeline; 10+ weeks if we add auto-apply and online scoring.

maria: tradeoffs: faster time-to-customer vs operational risk if recommendations are wrong. Must include canary, manual approval, and rollback.

tom: I'll design the offline pipeline and include an explainability payload with each rec (why we recommend quant level X). Example rollout policy snippet: 
```
rollout:
  percent: 10
  monitor: eval-alerts
  fallback: baseline-model
```

claire: will draft SLOs + runbook. Need to know alert types (regression magnitude, latency delta, cost delta). Proposing:
```
SLOs:
  latency_p99_delta: <= 10ms
  quality_regression: <= 3%
  cost_delta: positive savings > 0
```

beth: we'll hand over curated eval sets and production prompt slices for the pilot. We'll also collect customer acceptance criteria.

ajay: action items: ajay -> finalize advisor heuristics and API schema; tom -> prototype offline quant scorer + explainability; claire -> SLO + runbook draft; maria -> coordinate pilot onboarding with Acme (Beth).

maria: I'll freeze MVP scope by EOD tomorrow unless anyone objects. Please call out any blockers now. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature-branch/optimize-advisor (CI passed) :rocket:

ajay: :thumbsup:

beth: :thumbsup:

claire: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — I'll post the scope doc and acceptance checklist in #product and link in this thread.
